## Notes for sales

- No one-time 'buy forever' licence for Kshana Pro: without renewal a leaked copy cannot be stopped.
- Self-serve (Pro individual, team, academic, evidence packs under $5k) through a merchant of record once gate K3 clears; until then invoice and bank transfer (decision K3).
- Contracts (Enterprise, Sovereign, large evidence packs, QSP): one-page order form, invoice, bank transfer, net 14/30.
- Arksa plans and their included jobs are on Arksa's own list; Arksa-exclusive jobs are never sold standalone.
- Trade-secret methods run only on the hosted Kshana Pro service (results-only), with a monthly allowance per subscription.
